correctness.rationale: Under the isometric coordinate map f↦(f(0),f′), pointwise conjugation has complementary real spectral projections Q_λ and Q_μ for every distinct λ,μ on the unit circle. These give explicit nonzero orthogonal idempotents whose λ,μ combination is a Form III or IV surjective isometry, while an explicit allowed phase combination annihilates a nonzero test function. The separate λ₁² phase correction follows directly from equations (3.4) and (3.6).

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. No correction or counterexample to arXiv:2609.18967v1 was located. A related analytic-space manuscript contains similar real-linear ingredients but no matching all-phase C¹ counterexample was found. The 2019 corrigendum is a residual risk because only its abstract and bibliographic record were inspected.

value.rationale: The construction refutes the Form III and IV bicircularity conclusions and, for nonopposite phases such as 1 and i, the main dichotomy stated in the abstract of the current v1 preprint. It also isolates a reusable conjugation mechanism and an independent phase-covariance error in Forms I and II.
